headline: Indian IT services showed solid top‑line growth with TCS leading, while revenue momentum was mixed across peers.
summary: TCS reported 11.2% YoY revenue growth to ₹73,188 cr and a modest profit rise. Infosys and HCLTech posted double‑digit YoY revenue gains of 13.8% and 13.9% respectively, according to exchange data. Wipro's revenue was flat YoY, with only a 1% QoQ increase. Smaller players such as Coforge and OFSS delivered strong percentage growth but remain low‑base.

themes.title: AI monetisation
themes.detail: TCS highlighted AI revenue crossing $3.1 bn, now over 10% of total revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins varied, with OFSS at 59.6% but most peers around 15‑24%, indicating cost discipline challenges.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and profit growth, plus AI contribution above 10% of revenue.
13.8% YoY revenue rise and stable 21.1% operating margin.

laggards.why: Flat YoY revenue and modest QoQ increase, with operating margin only 15.7%.
Revenue growth modest at 17.4% YoY and margin at 14.4%.
